as_told.title: Larson's 747 number download and the Roswell date

plain: A former CIA officer named Ralph Moat Larson once had a dream in which, he says, he downloaded a string of numbers, including 747, and Jesse Michels wonders whether that number points to July 7, 1947, a date tied to the reported crash of an unknown craft near Roswell, New Mexico. Michels raises it himself while interviewing Larson, noting that the date appears in a book, and asking whether it connects to his '747' download. In a later episode Michels retells it secondhand, describing the download as a dream full of numbers and pointing to Larson's book A State of Mind: Faith and the CIA. If the link held, the dream would be pointing at the Roswell event.
